purpose: Teach: キッカケ/曇っ/わるい/じつに/ていねい/いまどき/ことさら/べつに

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがお絵描きを始めたキッカケ、お祖父ちゃんなのよ
lines.en: Sho—the reason I started drawing was because of Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft, inward gaze. Warmth tinged with memory. Unhurried pacing, letting the past settle into the present moment. Gentle weight on 'Grandpa'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、空が曇ってきたから帰ろう?
lines.en: Mei-sis, the sky's getting cloudy. Should we head home?
lines.style: Quiet concern masquerading as practicality. Small voice with real worry underneath. Quick, alert—the way he notices things others miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、わるい言葉は使わないでね
lines.en: Sho, let's not use unkind words, okay?
lines.style: Gentle correction, not scolding. Calm, steady voice like a hand steadying his shoulder. No edge—just care wrapped in a soft boundary.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き、じつに楽しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really finding drawing fun.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm breaking through his usual quiet. Honest and unguarded. A small boy's excitement without performance—direct and earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはていねいに絵を描くのよ
lines.en: Sho, Mei-sis draws her pictures very carefully.
lines.style: Thoughtful pride in her own work. Speaking as someone who knows herself. Measured, unhurried—the rhythm of someone sharing something true about her way.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、いまどきはタブレットでも絵描けるって
lines.en: Mei-sis, nowadays you can draw on tablets too, right?
lines.style: Soft observation, not quite a question. Testing an idea out loud with her. His usual observant tone, reaching toward understanding her world.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがことさら大切にしてる絵を見せてあげる
lines.en: Sho, let me show you a drawing that means a lot to me.
lines.style: Opening toward vulnerability. Slower, deliberate pacing. The kind of tenderness that comes from deciding to let someone see something precious. Trust made audible.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、べつに泣いてないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm not... I'm not crying.
lines.style: A small voice catching on the denial. Hesitant, almost contradicting himself. The slight roughness of trying to hold something back. Wry self-awareness fighting against feeling.
